evd_title: LLM review recommendation scores exceeded human scores without area-chair context but matched with it
finding: LLM review recommendation scores exceeded human scores without area-chair context but matched with it
P: ICLR/NeurIPS papers with OpenReview reviews (N per condition not reported)
I: GPT-4 reviews with 5 cumulative prompt contexts P1-P5 (review form, guides, ethics, AC guidelines, prior-year stats)
C: Human OpenReview reviewers' scores; ablation across P1-P5
O: Mean recommendation: human 5.88 (SD 1.61); P1 7.21; P2 7.58; P3 7.62; P4 4.61; P5 5.36
T: ICLR 2023/2024, NeurIPS 2022/2023 papers; GPT-4 snapshot not reported; paper 2024
